question: Should built-in Orgo support remain blocked until the full remote-resource identity, recovery, redirect, explicit-success, and hosted cleanup contract is implemented and proven?
rationale: The branch sends bearer credentials and creates or destroys paid remote resources, so maintainers must explicitly own the acceptable safety and product boundary before landing it.

options.title: Require the complete safety contract
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until every finding is fixed, current main is reconciled, and redacted hosted zero-retained-resource proof is provided.

options.title: Pause the built-in provider
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open but shelve or close this landing candidate if the real service contract and credentials cannot be safely validated.

recommendation.title: Require the complete safety contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until every finding is fixed, current main is reconciled, and redacted hosted zero-retained-resource proof is provided.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history on the exact Orgo lifecycle code and adjacent credential-boundary hardening.
